reviewers.role: An experienced lexicographer and teacher of Japanese who labels each word with topics from the list, using its JMdict senses and the topic of its OpenMoji picture as a hint.
A native Japanese speaker from Tokyo who has taught Japanese to adult learners for fifteen years and prepares students for the JLPT N5 to N3.
A native Japanese speaker from Osaka who teaches at a Japanese-language school (日本語学校) and writes theme-based lesson plans for beginners and intermediate learners.
A native Japanese speaker who leads the curriculum of a Japanese-language school; decides where the two teachers disagree and checks every sense entry the decision kept.
